chat.empty: No threads yet. Start one from the menu.
chat.placeholder: Message the boss (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
agents.name: Name
appearance.themeHint: System follows macOS day and night automatically.
vault.hint: Secrets are write-only: they can be set or replaced, never shown.
devices.pairHint: To pair another device, run `achords pair web` on the host.
pair.intro: Pair this browser: run `achords pair web` on the host and enter the code.
thread.bossError: Sorry, I could not handle that ({reason}).
thread.question: Question from {agent} ({title}): {question}
telegram.paired: Paired. I only listen to you from now on.
telegram.stopped: Emergency stop: {runs} run(s) killed, queue paused. The gateway is shutting down; run `achords resume` and `achords start` on the host to continue.
telegram.localOnly: This thread is now local-only: it runs on local models only and never reaches a cloud model. This cannot be undone; use /new for normal work.
telegram.voiceNoWhisper: Voice notes need local Whisper on the host (run `achords doctor`).
telegram.voiceTooLong: That voice note is too long (max {minutes} min).
telegram.voiceFailed: Could not transcribe the voice note: {reason}
agents.allowedHelp: Ticked models are allowed for this agent; the dot marks the default. Aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) always use the newest version.
chat.mic: Record a voice note (transcribed on this machine)
action.noPendingMove: No pending move for this card.
kanban.override: Outside the workflow rules: allowed for you, logged as an override.
kanban.keyboardHelp: Space to pick up, ←/→ to choose a column, Enter to drop, Esc to cancel.
kanban.rulesHelp: Who may move a card into each column (read-only; edit workflows/{ws}.yaml on the host).
kanban.noRules: no rule: only the owner, as a logged override
kanban.empty: No cards in this workspace yet.
agents.form.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; cannot be changed later.
agents.form.roleHelp: What the agent is, e.g. "Web developer". Fixed after creation.
agents.form.descriptionHelp: What it does, what it does not do, what it hands to whom. Saved as AGENT.md; the first paragraph is what the boss sees when routing work.
agents.form.rolesHelp: Kanban permissions, comma separated, e.g. qa. Separate from the job role.
agents.form.permissionsHelp: Everything starts off. Switch on only what this agent needs.
agents.form.pathsHelp: Absolute paths, one per line (~/ works).
agents.form.shellHelp: Command prefixes, one per line, e.g. npm test. Anything else needs your approval.
agents.form.networkHelp: Allowed hosts, one per line. Empty = none.
telegram.projectSet: Project for this thread: {name} ({slug}). Its PROJECT.md applies to new work here.
telegram.projectCleared: This thread has no project now.
projects.help: A project holds one client's rules (PROJECT.md) and working folder (files/). Work started in a thread with a project follows its PROJECT.md; agents of the project's workspace work directly in its folder.
projects.name: Name
projects.finderHint: Open the folder in Finder (⌘⇧G, paste the path) to add files or edit PROJECT.md next to files/.
projects.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. acme-shop; also the folder name and the Telegram /project argument.
projects.workspaceHelp: Agents of this workspace get access to the project's folder.
chat.projectHelp: New work in this thread follows the project's PROJECT.md.
rooms.help: Discussions agents opened among themselves. They are kept out of your chats and Telegram; this read-only log is for cost control and checking what was said.
usage.warn: Heads-up: {provider} {window} is at {percent}% ({resets}). Agents stop when it is used up.
usage.help: Subscription windows as the Claude CLI reports them after every run. You get a note in your thread at 80% and 95%.
usage.empty: No run has reported its quota yet.
usage.spentToday: API-equivalent cost of today's runs: ${usd} (on a subscription this is not billed; it shows how much work was done).
